findings.issue: Frontend whitespace validation rejects backend-valid ticket tags containing edge U+FEFF text.
findings.disposition: Fixed: Frontend canonical Unicode whitespace agrees with producer; original accepted historical text remains readable.

findings.issue: Handled late summary publication failure leaves unpublished ticket tags in the saved ledger until recovery.
findings.disposition: Fixed: Handled replacement failures eagerly recover the prior publication set, with honest incomplete/ambiguous recovery diagnostics.

findings.issue: Filtered refetches can omit newly observed tag values from controls and legend and leave points without a color.
findings.disposition: Fixed: Filtered responses reconcile ticket metadata into catalogs; current values always have controls, legend and assigned colors.
